svg.aria-label: A Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience and a Graduate Student at SJSU. Currently working on distributed datacenter networking software as a Software Development Engineer Intern at Nokia. Before my masters I was working as a Software Engineer at Gen Digital (formerly Norton Lifelock / Symantec) building consumer security products for Windows. On campus I worked as a Teaching Assistant for Software System Design graduate course and Database Management System undergraduate course, and Graduate Research Assistant working on an AI platform. I also hosted and managed creative events and activities for students on campus during my time as a Treasurer for the Art & Design Society club. I have previously worked with: C++, Go, Java, Python, React, TypeScript, Javascript, Node, SQL, MongoDB, AWS
